title: SS27 Girls' Design and Production Innovations
summary: Design and production for girlswear: story-led collections, durable construction, product data for the EU passport.
research_period: Pitti Bimbo 103, Florence, 24-25 June 2026; Playtime Paris, 28-30 June 2026; analysis July to November 2026
markets: Premium and mid-market childrenswear, Europe-led fairs, global retail

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Halcyon Nights builds several graphic universes each season with patterns from a panel of artists; Bobo Choses publishes illustrated books alongside its collections<sup>[1]</sup>
- Newer lines emphasise breathability, quick drying and comfort; childrenswear is moving toward functionality, material quality and durability<sup>[2]</sup>
- The EU textiles Digital Product Passport delegated act is planned for the fourth quarter of 2027; since 19 July 2026 large companies may not destroy certain unsold apparel<sup>[3]</sup>

sections.heading: Actions
sections.body:
- Build stories across products.
- Record fibre, origin and safety tests.

design_implications:
- Grade for growth.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
